claim.statement: Events (deploys, restarts, health, jobs, alerts, faults, token changes) are kept per node in memory (newest 1024) and shown by the TUI, dashboard and relish; live log follow is exposed as server-sent events and a WebSocket; the durable record is the audit log.

claim.measurable: Generate more than 1024 events on one node and verify the oldest are gone while relish audit still has them; curl -N the SSE log follow endpoint; each job run raises exactly one event (job-completed, job-failed, job-cancelled, job-unknown, job-skipped).
claim.gap: No documented external event subscription or watch API for cluster state (rg -n -i "watch stream|event stream|/v1/events" README.md docs/whitepaper.md docs/manual docs/README.md found no user-facing route). The Brioche design lists /events and /events/stream (docs/design/ui-brioche.md lines 1940, 1948) but the user docs do not.
